original_test_intent: Obtain the authoritative ComputerSystem identity for the selected Redfish System and retain a secure read-only identity record, after the project resolves whether the target is the standard member `Id` or a documented OEM `ComputerSystemId` property.
original_method: Discover the System member from `/redfish/v1/Systems`, GET its advertised resource using trusted curl/jq, then extract only the project-approved standard or OEM identity path and validate type, format, uniqueness and member association.
manual_activity: The firmware/schema owner resolves whether acceptance is the advertised ComputerSystem member `Id` or a vendor OEM `ComputerSystemId`, supplies its exact path/type/format/uniqueness policy, and approves identity-data disclosure.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Validated Systems collection and target member
Decision: standard member Id or documented OEM ComputerSystemId
Exact approved JSON path, type, format and uniqueness policy
Identity redaction and secure evidence policy
safety_requirements: Do not recursively search all OEM fields
Do not conflate member URI Id with an OEM property
Reject missing, duplicate or ambiguous identity
agent_execution_scope: Resolve approved System member from collection
Extract only the approved identity path
Validate identity/member association, type, format and uniqueness
Capture redacted status/headers/value metadata and raw hash
Archive decision provenance and no-mutation audit
engineer_actions: Approve expected identity schema and disclosure scope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: curl/jq fit a read-only query, but the command assumes `/Systems/system` and scans arbitrary OEM descendants. Its jq binding also does not reliably retrieve the value from the original root after emitting path arrays, so even a same-named field is not trustworthy evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After the owner chooses the identity contract, resolve the advertised System member, GET it with trusted TLS and extract exactly the approved standard `Id` or OEM JSON path, requiring one non-empty value of the specified type/format tied to that member.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The ComputerSystem resource read and 15/10 timing remain; no member ID, OEM path or identity semantics are inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Separate discovery of the member URI/standard `Id` from validation of any additional OEM ComputerSystemId, and run only the owner-selected checkpoint with an explicit path.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves the title/path circularity, removes recursive OEM guessing and unsafe access, and adds type/format/uniqueness/privacy checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The review does not claim both standard and OEM identities are required; it preserves the ambiguity until the project selects the intended acceptance target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Identity values may be stable, serial-like or topology-sensitive. An exact path can move across firmware revisions, so schema/version provenance and redaction remain mandatory.

project_override_considerations: If both identities are required, they must become two explicitly accepted checkpoints with a defined mapping. A Redfish SDK is equivalent only if it preserves advertised member identity, the approved exact field path and certificate-bound evidence.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC and selected System member identity
Approved standard-versus-OEM decision with firmware/schema provenance
Exact JSON path, type/format and uniqueness policy
HTTP status/content type and access-controlled raw hash
One redacted validated identity tied to the member
No recursive search, alternate identity substitution or state/log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master title says to get ComputerSystemId, but the procedure already requires `{ComputerSystemId}` to address the resource and never identifies a returned field. This is circular and leaves standard member Id versus OEM property unresolved. DeepSeek's OEM interpretation is not authority and cannot silently repair the Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The owner can resolve the ambiguity by selecting one documented identity contract and exact path. Once supplied, the operation is a bounded read-only query with concrete validation controls.

review_improvement: Preserves the title/path conflict and replaces recursive OEM guessing with an owner-approved standard-or-OEM identity contract and exact-path validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A ComputerSystem member is normally already identified by its collection link and resource `Id`; using that identifier in the request cannot by itself prove a distinct field was discovered. Conversely, an OEM property named ComputerSystemId may have different semantics and privacy impact. Searching all OEM descendants by key name can bind to the wrong vendor object or multiple values. The project must choose the intended identity, after which the collector can enforce one exact path and prove it belongs to the selected member.
